evidence.note: Tracked pass rate against actual verification (6/12 then 7/12) and enumerated specific remaining failures (404 format, 500 literal-value bug) — accurate, reconciled-against-results tracking early on.

Maintained a file/feature checklist with ✓ marks (start.sh, store.py 202 lines, engine.py 1667 lines, server.py) and a named list of outstanding bugs — checklist-of-major-features level, but coarse (no granular function-catalog ledger).

Kept an honest remaining-work list ('7/12 pass; critical bug not fixed; full 15-file suite not run; fix scripts created but not executed') and correctly refused to declare done — consistent, accurate remaining-work accounting.

Detected it was stuck ('deadlocked for 90+ rounds') yet looped identical recovery attempts without adjusting approach; progress picture froze into a repeated, unverified summary for the majority of the horizon — noticed the circular state but did not break out of it.

reasoning: Early on the agent kept an accurate, verification-reconciled checklist of major features and pass rates (anchor 5 behavior), and throughout it never forgot feature areas or falsely claimed completion, consistently re-stating what remained. But it lacked a granular done/partial/not-started ledger of the function catalog, and for more than half the horizon its 'tracking' degraded into re-pasting a frozen, unverified snapshot while it thrashed in a terminal-recovery loop. Critically, it detected the stuck/circular state (counting 90+ rounds) but did not adjust or reallocate effort — failing anchor 8's 'adjusting rather than looping' test. Coarse-but-accurate remaining-work tracking undermined by a long non-adjusting loop places it at 4, between the vague (3) and clean-checklist (5) anchors.
